summary: Tested new full-page Product Detail and Order Detail refactor (replacing modals). Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass (refresh endpoint 4 + detail-pages regression 6). Frontend: full product-detail-page and order-detail-page render with every required data-testid, images strip renders 20 images, variants table renders 6 rows, save button disabled/enabled dirty state works, refresh button correctly enabled (has source_url), change-category popover opens, back button collapses detail, deep-link from global search opens ProductDetailPage, deep-link from notifications opens ProductDetailPage. Order status tracker exposes all 7 buttons and PATCH to /api/orders/{id} works. Customer + delivery address cards render with fallback text.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — a <span> is rendered inside a native <select><option>. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up to avoid hydration errors.
Recharts logs 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on initial mount — container likely has 0 dimensions during first paint. Cosmetic but noisy in console.

action_items: Optional: remove <span> wrapper inside <option> elements in Select components (hydration warning).
Optional: set explicit min height on recharts container to silence width/height warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductDetailPage/OrderDetailPage are inside App.js (~4000+ lines total). Consider extracting into /app/frontend/src/pages/ for maintainability — App.js is well over the 700-line guideline.
Old ProductEditModal + OrderDetailsModal remain in-file but unused; safe to delete to prevent confusion.
product-code-input uses readonly HTML attr correctly (verified). Good.
test_credentials: N/A — admin endpoints unauthenticated per problem statement.
seed_data_creation: Only ephemeral TEST_ prefixed products created and torn down inside pytest fixtures.
